description: Frontend Document Upload UI and Provider Selection - Add a document translation page with file upload, provider selection dropdown, and job status tracking. Update the existing translate page to include provider choice. Add a user settings page for managing stored provider API keys and credits.
steps: Create frontend/src/pages/DocumentTranslatePage.tsx - Page with: file upload dropzone (drag & drop or click), source/target language selectors, provider dropdown (MarianMT Free, OpenAI, HuggingFace, Google), option to use own key or pay credits, submit button, and a job history list showing status of previous uploads.
Create frontend/src/components/FileUpload.tsx - Reusable drag-and-drop file upload component with file type validation (PDF, DOCX, TXT) and size limit display.
Create frontend/src/components/ProviderSelector.tsx - Reusable provider selection component showing: provider name, pricing info (free vs credit cost), and whether user has stored a key for it.
Create frontend/src/components/JobStatusCard.tsx - Card component showing document translation job status (pending/processing/completed/failed), with download button when complete.

Create frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx - User settings page with tabs: API Keys (existing functionality), Provider Keys (manage BYOK keys for each provider), Credits (view balance, purchase credits).
Create frontend/src/hooks/useDocumentTranslation.ts - Hook for document upload API calls (upload file, poll job status, download result).
Update frontend/src/pages/TranslatePage.tsx - Add provider selector below language bar, allowing users to choose translation provider for text translation too.
Update frontend/src/App.tsx - Add routes for /documents and /settings.
Update frontend/src/components/Header.tsx - Add navigation links for Documents and Settings.
acceptance_criteria: Document translate page allows file upload via drag-and-drop or file picker
Only PDF, DOCX, TXT files are accepted with clear error for other types
Provider selector shows all available providers with pricing context
Job status updates are shown after upload submission
User settings page allows managing BYOK provider keys
Text translate page now includes provider selection option
All new pages are accessible via header navigation
Frontend builds successfully with TypeScript strict mode
verification: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build to verify frontend compiles with all new pages and components
Verify no TypeScript errors in the build output
